_doc: RenderWare clean layer subsystems (docs/rw_clean.md). Each subsystem lists the decomp units it replaces (units), the port transcriptions it retires (port_sources) and its clean sources (sources, src/rwclean). CMake P4_RW_CLEAN selects subsystems (empty: the default list below; none: none); the census baselines are those of the default. A clean source's FUN_ markers make it the only owner of those retail addresses: the mirror strips the definitions at them from every other compiled unit.
